# laravelforge_org_team_invite (Resource)

Manages a pending invitation to a Laravel Forge team. The API has no update endpoint, so any change recreates the invitation.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address of the invited member. Create-only; changing it recreates the invitation.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `role_id` (Number) ID of the role to grant the invited member. Create-only; changing it recreates the invitation.
- `team_id` (Number) ID of the team to invite the member to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the invitation.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
